verdict: Paid ads have been paused 20 days; leads are at a standstill.
narrative: All 17 leads this period arrived in the first week (July 30–August 6), when Meta ads were running at $29.41 per lead. Ads have been dark since August 7, and zero leads have come in since. Search traffic is actually up 39% week-over-week, which shows real intent in the market — but without a paid capture layer running, that intent has nowhere to go. Ads are being reactivated, and SMS follow-up automation goes live by August 31 to make sure every new lead is contacted immediately. Once paid media is back on, you should see leads resume at a pace consistent with that first week.
